To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
photonic crystal biosensors can be used for detection of antibiotics with high specificity and detection range can be extended by combining different PC biosensors on the same chip.
photonic crystal biosensor arrays on silicon chip can be utilized for the detection of antibiotics with high sensitivity, specificity and multiplex capability.

we have developed a new type of biosensor that is able to detect a specific antibiotic, gentamicine, with a detection limit of 0.1nM, which is a 10-fold lower than the lowest concentration that is normally found in human urine, and a 1000-fold lower than the minimum concentration that is normally used for antibiotic treatment.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the detection of a small molecule, gentamicin.
the development and application of PC biosensors for specific detection of low molecular weight antibiotics.
the design, fabrication, and characterization of a photonic crystal sensor array for the specific and sensitive detection of antibiotics.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

this work presents the first demonstration of PC biosensors in the field of antibiotic detection, with a detection range that is comparable to the best results in the literature, while the specificity of the detection is much improved.

the silicon-on-chip PC biosensor arrays can be used to detect antibiotics with very high sensitivity and specificity, and thus can be used for the development of a portable and rapid diagnostic tool for antibiotic residue detection.
the PC microcavity biosensors are capable of detecting antibiotics with high specificity and sensitivity.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the silicon-based PC biosensor array is a powerful tool for the detection of antibiotics with high specificity and sensitivity.
the PC microcavities are promising biosensor candidates for detecting small molecules with high specificity.
the PC biosensor array can be a promising platform for the detection of various biomolecules with high specificity.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the silicon-on-chip PC sensor arrays can be used to detect a broad range of biomolecules with high specificity.
PC microcavities are a promising platform to realize high-performance and low-cost biosensor arrays.
PC biosensors are promising for specific detection of antibiotics and other small molecules.
